title: MZ Ryan's Adventure - Classic JRPG In Memory Of My Brother

posts.author: RyansAdventures
posts.body:
Hello everyone! I've been lurking here for a bit (and gathering free-to-use resources), but I wanted to make a post to get feedback regarding my game.
Spoiler:
Disclaimers
Disclaimers:
My project contains elements of religion and politics. Especially regarding the latter, there is strong political satire that some may find offensive.
I did use Suno.ai to make an arrangement for a the battle theme I wrote. I actually did write the melody for the battle theme and hummed it into the Suno.ai recorder, so I own the melody. But I used Suno to create an orchestral arrangement. I do pay $10 a month for Suno, so I own the copyright to the arrangement, in addition to the melody I wrote.
Synopsis:
My brother Ryan died unexpectedly last year. We always used to play games, both video games and Dungeons and Dragons, together. He would have wanted to be made into a video game hero. So I did it. I grew up playing Final Fantasy on the SNES and PSX, and I am also a fan of Phantasy Star 1-4, Dragon Quest 1-8, and my favorite game is Chrono Trigger. I am trying to make a classic RPG in a similar style (not really groundbreaking), but with my quirky, politically incorrect humor (which again, if you find politically incorrect humor offensive, then this is not your game). I basically used my last DND campaign I created before my brother died as the main plot/setting. Probably full of cliches, but I like cliches! They are cliche for a reason...
I am using RPG Maker MZ, mostly RTP assets, VisuStella, the Odyssey of Fantasy pack, Kevin MacLeod royalty-free music, and some free-to-use assets I found on this forum. Here are the full credits:
